Can you hea-WWwW|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 36 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Incoming mysterious boss!|Beginning of Wave 36 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Golden Mode|Golden]])}} {{QuoteBox|Incoming dark and mysterious boss!|Beginning of Wave 36 (Pre-[[Polluted Wasteland]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Summoner Boss''' is a boss [[Enemies|enemy]] that can summon [[Mystery|Mysteries]] and [[Mystery Boss|Mystery Bosses]]. For its debut, it has high health (higher than the [[Tank]]) but slightly slow speed (slower than the [[Mystery Boss]]). It debuts alongside the [[Error]]. The '''Summoner Boss''' only appears in the [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode and [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. It also appears in certain [[Challenge Maps]]. The '''Summoner Boss''' is replaced by the [[Necromancer King]] in any map with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. ==Appearance== The '''Summoner Boss''' has reflective grey skin and purple glowing eyes. Because of its reflective skin, its skin color will be different on various maps, though generally it is black or dark grey. Its torso and legs are pebble black. It also wears a reflective dark granite cloak. It has red diamond-plated armbands and large grey skull shoulder-pads, with purple eyes and large horns. It wears a purple respirator mask, a bowler hat with playing cards on it and wields a staff that emits purple electricity whenever enemies are summoned. It has a twisted left leg. ==Strategy== *Deal with this enemy as soon as possible. Leaving the '''Summoner Boss''' alive for too long will allow it to summon a vast amount of enemies. **Place towers closer to the spawn to have a better chance at dealing with the '''Summoner Boss''' before it can summon anything. *The [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are great at dealing with the '''Summoner Boss''' and the [[Mystery Boss]]es it summons. **You may want to set these towers to ''Strongest'' to ignore the enemies that the '''Summoner Boss''' spawns. **You can boost the firerate of these towers with the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability whenever the '''Summoner Boss''' spawns. *Area of effect towers, such as the [[Executioner]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]], can be great at dealing with enemies summoned by the '''Summoner Boss'''. **They can also be useful at dealing damage to the '''Summoner Boss'''. Do note, however, that these towers do not have enough DPS to deal with the '''Summoner Boss''' on their own. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} SummonerBossPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSummonerBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} B7c7f6fa86bcabb01df77e2d666e090b.jpg|'''Summoner Boss''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} IconJ.png|'''Summoner Boss''' on the game icon. MegaUpdateSlantIcon.png|'''Summoner Boss''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} EHNzIeTXkAAMpNt.jpg|'''Summoner Boss''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} April Fools 2022 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Summoner Boss''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Summoner Boss''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SummonerBossIconIG.png|'''Summoner Boss''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Summoner Boss''' is considered to be the successor of the [[Necromancer 2]]. *The '''Summoner Boss's''' breathing mask is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|3963699748|Deep Space Half Gas Mask}} from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Summoner Boss's''' face is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|12467159|Ghostface}} from the Roblox catalog. *Prior to the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]], the '''Summoner Boss''' could summon enemies which remained in the air. *Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Summoner Boss''' was one of the few enemies to gain a shield.
